documentation.title: Group Use Trailing Comma
documentation.standard:
For single-line group use statements, there should be no comma after the last import.
For multi-line group use statements, there should be a comma after the last import.

code.title: Valid: Single-line group use statement without a comma after the last import.
Invalid: Single-line group use statement with a comma after the last import.
Valid: Multi-line group use statement with a comma after the last import.
Invalid: Multi-line group use statement without a comma after the last import.
